replication.target_description: EmpaToM empathy: age × video emotionality interaction on valence ratings, explicitly designated in Methods.

n.location: Methods: Participants (final sample); Data analysis (outcome-specific outliers)
n.quote: The final sample comprised 42 younger (21 females, age range = 18–30, M = 24.00, s.d. = 3.20) and 44 older (22 females, age range = 65–77, M = 69.50, s.d. = 3.74) individuals. ... Furthermore, we excluded three participants (OA = 1, YA = 2) from the analysis of empathy and one participant (YA = 1) from the analysis of compassion due to them being extreme outliers (greater than 3 s.d.) on the valence ratings or concern rating, respectively.
n.sample_role: Participants in empathy age-group analysis; 40 younger and 43 older.
n.exclusions: 15 excluded during/after session before final groups of 42 younger/44 older. Empathy excludes YA = 2, OA = 1 extreme outliers (>3 s.d.). Two below-chance participants retained. Technical/button-box and sleep trials excluded and scores proportionally adjusted.

es.location: Results: Social affect: empathy and compassion, first paragraph; supplied locator p. 7 (no PDF)
es.quote: no significant interaction effect (F1,81 = 0.078, p = 0.780, ηp2 = 0.0001)
